title: Nightcord at 25:00 Chapter1 Episode16 Before I Disappear

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Huh? You went back to that place?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm going to make a song for Yuki. I want to save her.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I see. So you talked to Miku...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And she says Yuki doesn't really want to disappear.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I know there's nothing I can do even if I go, and I can't understand exactly what Yuki's going through.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But I feel like I should at least let her know how I feel.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I want her to know how much I'd miss her if she was gone.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Alright. I'll let you know before I go back.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Don't you two think you're making a big deal out of all this?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<It's not like Yuki is somehow special.
Everybody has their own problems.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I guess her being in that SEKAI place isn't exactly normal.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But still, that's not enough to make me want to go to a place like that just for her sake.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Alright. I guess it's just the two of us, K.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I have to finish this soon...before Yuki disappears.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Should I use strings as the main melody?
No, I need something deeper.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I need something that'll reach Yuki, and fast.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But what if I'm simply repeating the same mistake as I did before?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (The song I wrote for my dad only made things worse for him.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This song I'm writing for Yuki might end up doing the same thing to her.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (If my music ends up hurting someone again...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: However, I am sure that if anything is able to help her...it will be your music.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I put myself into my music—my desire to give happiness to others with my songs.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Maybe that kind of music doesn't really have the power to save anyone.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Even so, I still want to believe what Miku said is true.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I want to save Yuki with my music. For real this time.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I need to let Amia know.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <K! Have you really finished the song?!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wow, that was fast. What kind of song is it?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I see. So this is how it turned out.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <K, this song will reach her for sure.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yeah. Would you listen to it for me too, Enanan?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Your songs always feel so warm, K.>
